text_block_list.text:
At last, the day of the Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes
has arrived.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
As expected of a GⅠ race~
The grandstands are completely packed with fans.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: "...It seems your nerves are running especially high as well, Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Then I shall leave the role of being nervous
to you again today, Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
“—Today's challenge is not just
the race known as the Asahi Hai FS.”

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Right now, the only name on the minds of everyone in the audience is surely Maruzensky.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: That is precisely why... I shall rise to the challenge.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Not as a "second generation" or a "successor,"
but proving her ability as one who reaches the peak—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I shall be certain to show you.
